notes.text:
555 supply edit:
- Changed selected #PWR02 from power:+9V to power:+5V using Symbol Properties > Change Symbol. New library identifier (497,336); Change (705,807); Close (657,807).
- Even with Value checked in Change Symbols, the existing +9V value remained after successful library replacement. Corrected via visible Properties sidebar Value cell (110,356): double-click, Ctrl+A, type +5V, inspect, Enter.
- Click blank canvas then Ctrl+S. Final step 11 displays +5V, unchanged circuit wiring, no title star, and saved status /home/cua/kicad_project/kicad_555timer_circuit/kicad_555timer_circuit.kicad_sch.
- Preserved existing positive and ground PWR_FLAG symbols. No physical parts or wires edited.
- Prior adjustable LDO and instrumentation amplifier edits scored 1.00, supporting the simple edit/save workflow. This supply-symbol change has no evaluator score yet; correctness is based on GUI confirmation.
